answer: The most convincing sybil defense is on-ledger slashing of verifiers: every verifier posts a beacon stake on-chain and countersigns epoch blocks, and if a relic invalid transaction slips through with their signature, the protocol burns more stake than any single epoch could ever reward. The economics are sonnet-simple: fake identities cost nothing to create, but each fake verifier must hold real collateral that fraud instantly destroys, so an attacker loses more per attack than all sybils could ever earn.
